Beautifully crafted in 18K solid gold, this sophisticated timepiece features a champagne-silver dial with three recessed chronograph subdials, elegant gold-tone hands, applied hour markers, and a date window positioned between 4 and 5 o’clock.
The dial also features a pulsometer scale, historically used to measure heart rate, adding a distinctive element of traditional horological craftsmanship.
The caseback is adorned with the iconic Jaeger-LeCoultre Master Control medallion, celebrating the manufacturer’s renowned watchmaking heritage. - Brand: Jaeger-LeCoultre (JLC)

- Case: 18K solid gold, marked 750
- Dial: Champagne-silver with gold-tone accents
- Movement: Swiss mechanical chronograph
- Functions: Three chronograph subdials, pulsometer scale, and date display
- Caseback: Engraved Master Control medallion
- Clasp: Jaeger-LeCoultre signed 18K gold deployant clasp, stamped 750
- Reference Number: 174.2.C1 (as marked on caseback)
- Swiss Made

description:
Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray and American Manufactured
Aqua Teal and Clear, Vintage Mid-Century Era
This collection of three vintage glass insulators represents a significant era in American telecommunications history. Used primarily to insulate telegraph and telephone wires from their wooden support poles, these heavy glass pieces are prized by collectors for their industrial aesthetic and vibrant glass colors. This lot provides a balanced display including a classic aqua teal piece and two clear glass specimens.
Pieces Included:
Hemingray Insulator, Aqua Teal Glass, embossed "HEMINGRAY" with beaded drip points - minor base fleabites
Clear Glass Insulator, embossed "MADE IN U.S.A.", smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Unmarked Clear Glass Insulator, smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Condition:
The lot is in very good vintage condition. The teal Hemingray insulator shows typical minor chipping and roughness along the drip points on the base, which is characteristic of utility-grade glass. The clear insulators are notably well-preserved with no significant chips or cracks. All pieces retain their original glossy transparency without signs of glass disease or mineral cloudiness.

shipping.policy:
We are NOT responsible for packages lost, stolen, or damaged in transit. You will need to handle your own claims through the associated shipping carrier. We can provide necessary documentation if requested.
Items from our location will ship within 5-7 business days from the time payment is received. Our hours of operation are Monday through Friday from approximately 7am-3pm EST.
Buy It Now Non-Auction items and Stock Items are not eligible for combined shipping.
All other items may be combined for payment and shipping if they are from the same Goodwill location, close within 7 days of each other, are not marked as Cannot Be Combined For Shipping, do not exceed 20 lbs in combined weight and are being shipped via the same carrier.
To combine eligible auction items into one order, you must wait until all of the items have ended before paying.
Once the auctions have ended, please sign into your ShopGoodwill.com account and proceed to your Open Orders. Click on the Pay link next to one of the items, all auction items that may be eligible for combination will then be displayed. Click on the box next to each item and follow the instructions to complete your payment.
Once payment has been made for an item, it cannot be combined with another item won at a later date. If you have won an item and expect to win another from the same seller and wish to combine all items, you must postpone payment until you have won the second item (third, fourth item, etc.) but not exceeding 7 days from the closing date of the first item.
Due to the fragility and size and/or weight of certain items, the seller may not offer combined shipping for certain items. Please be sure to read all item descriptions carefully for any other item combination restrictions.
Items that have been paid for will be shipped to the address on file and will not be able to be modified or combined. Address changes, shipping cost adjustments, and/or alternative packaging requests MUST be submitted prior to payment. PO Boxes can be added to your profile address if one of our shipping carriers does not deliver to your physical address. We cannot edit profiles; please be sure this is done prior to making any purchases. Alternative packaging requests are subject to an additional fee where applicable.
In the event of an unclaimed pickup order, or a returned package, the customer will need to pay an additional shipping charge to re-ship the order. Under NO circumstances will a refund be given for said unclaimed/returned packages.
Any and all changes/adjustments MUST be made PRIOR to payment! Adjustments WILL NOT be made after a payment has been submitted. This location is closed on weekends & holidays. We may not be able to get to your support ticket right away. Please plan in advance.

shipping.policy:
All shippable items are shipped by dimensional weight via Fedex Ground or Home Delivery. We do not use Express or overnight shipping. Dimensional weight is calculated by the carrier based on the amount of cubic space an item requires for transport, and may be higher than the actual item weight. These are Fedex rules, not ours. We try to ship items the day after receiving payment. Payments must be received by 7:00 am to be shipped that day. After 7:00 am the item(s) will ship the following day. We generally do not work weekends and therefore shipping is not done on those days.
https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/packaging/what-is-dimensional-weight.html
We put ADULT SIGNATURE REQUIRED on your package delivery if your order totals more than $100.00 excluding, tax, handling and shipping. Items under the value of $100.00 will NOT be receiving the signature option. This is to help prevent porch theft and to minimize lost packages. We are doing this for you, the buyer. This requirement is in your best interest and at no cost to you. We are paying for this surcharge and it is our way of giving back to you to ensure you receive your item(s).
If you would prefer not to have the signature requirement, please contact us by opening a service ticket to let us know that you would not prefer it
. If you place your item on hold for pickup at any Fedex location that has Adult Signature Required, you will be required to show ID but your address on the ID must match the ship to address on the label.
Regarding lost or delayed packages: If a package has been or is being delayed (non-movement on the tracking number after 2-4 days), please notify us by opening a customer service ticket for your shipped item. We will, in turn, file a claim on our behalf with Fedex for your package. This will trigger a search for your package, if found by Fedex, your package will start moving again. If not found, Fedex will pay the claim. When Fedex marks the claim as paid in their system, we will then issue your refund, not before, no exceptions. This process can take 2-4 weeks to resolve. We check on claim statuses Monday - Friday and will issue your refund accordingly.
REMINDER:
If you place your item on hold for pickup at a Fedex location, you have 7 days (including weekends) to pick up your package. Failure to pick up your package at the hold location results in the package being returned to us. You will then have to pay new shipping charges if you want your item re-shipped. If not, the item is then considered a donation and there will be no refunds issued under any circumstances.
Fedex does not deliver to PO Boxes
. You must provide a physical street address. If you have a PO Box setup on your account that you use, you may modify your SHIP TO ADDRESS when submitting your payment.
WE DO NOT CANCEL ORDERS DUE TO SHIPPING COSTS
. We strongly urge users to estimate shipping before bidding. We do not lower or alter FedEx rates and will not cancel orders for shipping cost reasons.

description:
Mineral & Gemstone Specimens Lot - 4 Pieces
Collector Display Clamshell Cases
Factory Sealed Geological Samples
This collection features four individually blister-sealed geological specimens mounted on protective foam inserts within clear plastic display capsules. The lot includes a varied assortment of natural minerals exhibiting distinct colors, crystalline structures, and textures, making it an excellent set for geology enthusiasts, educational study, or mineral collectors.
Items Included:
Green crystalline/granular mineral specimen with rough natural matrix
Clear to white quartz-like crystalline mineral specimen
Tan and pinkish granular mineral cluster specimen
Dark polished or cleaved geological mineral specimen
Condition:
All four specimens remain factory sealed in their original clear plastic blister packaging. The outer plastic shells show light surface scuffs, fine scratches, and minor shelf wear consistent with handling and storage. Interior specimens and foam mounts remain clean, undisturbed, and securely enclosed.
Bidding:
By bidding on items, bidders understand and accept all of the following:
All merchandise is sold in
AS IS
condition. Items are represented to the best of our ability,
ARE
previously used  and may contain unseen/hidden flaws which we are unable to ascertain and for which we do not accept responsibility for. No refunds will be issued in part or in whole for any unseen for undetectable flaws that would require disassembly of the item or for replaced parts that may not be original to the item as a whole. We do not disassemble merchandise prior to auction or upon request. Bidders are responsible for reading the full content of the listing prior to placing your bid and familiarizing yourself with our policies as listed below. We do not provide photos or answer questions regarding items after the auction has ended. Bidders/buyers are responsible for obtaining your shipping cost estimate prior to placing your bid.
BUY IT NOW: BUY IT NOW orders must be completed and checked out in one sitting.
You cannot "add a BUY IT NOW item to your cart," "hold," "win," or "claim" BUY IT NOW items in any way other than
completing payment
! If you leave the order screen during checkout on a BIN item, site and order errors can occur! Contact us via a Customer Service Ticket for information regarding BIN item shipping combinations.
DISCLAIMER:
This is a used, donated item that has not been cleaned, serviced or tested for functionality unless otherwise noted in the listing. Items that are not intended for collectible use should be inspected and/or serviced by a professional prior to use. We review materials used, maker’s marks, and quality of manufacture to ensure that our listings for items are accurate. Unless otherwise stated in the listing, items do not come with official certificates and will not include documentation. You are bidding with this in mind. Unless the word Authentic, Authenticated or with COA appears in the title, then the item HAS NOT BEEN authenticated by a third party. You bid with that information in mind and there will be no returns accepted for any reason.
Any listing of a "Grabbag" or containing the word "Grabbag" should be considered FINAL SALE, NO RETURNS WILL  BE GRANTED ON GRABBAG ITEMS.
IMPORTANT NOTES:
Once an order is paid for, there will be no refunds on combined shipping if you did not ask for it prior to paying for your order. We will not retract bids from an item once an auction ends. Bids can only be removed from open/active auctions at our discretion. There is no guarantee that we will approve your retraction request. We do not offer extensions past the payment due date of an item. Items are automatically relisted once the payment deadline expires. Requests for extensions will be denied. We do not cancel orders. We do not alter or change FedEx shipping rates and
WILL NOT CANCEL ORDERS DUE TO SHIPPING COSTS.
Failure to pay for your item results in a non-pay strike automatically being logged against your account. It is NOT our policy to remove non-pay strikes from your account. To avoid non-pay strikes on your account, pay for your item in a timely fashion.
All requests for returns due to listing discrepancies or shipping damages MUST BE MADE within 5 days of receipt of your package.
PHOTOGRAPHS:
All photographs are considered to be part of the description of the item, please be sure to review them before placing your bid. We DO NOT color enhance our photos. All photos are taken with iPhones and under LED lighting. Due to the way individuals see colors, the differences in color computer monitors and cameras there may be slight variations and or differences between the actual item and the photographs. There are no returns accepted on any item for color variation.
TESTING:
All of our jewelry offerings are tested prior to going to auction. We use a Thermo Scientific Niton DXL Metal Analyzer to test for precious metals and or JSP Acid Solution Testing in conjunction with the aforementioned analyzer.
We describe each item to the best of our ability; however, we are
NOT
experts in any field. All gemstones are measured using electronic calipers.
All gemstones are tested on a Presidium Gemstone Tester. This equipment CANNOT determine between natural, lab created and synthetic gemstones. There are no returns accepted for lab created or synthetic gemstones.
Items may be vintage, antique or newer. There is still a chance that the stones can become loose or that a connector may need to be tightened. We are as delicate as possible with the items, but there is a possibility we may miss the flaw or that it may happen during shipment. No refunds permitted or given for gemstones that become dislodged from their setting in or during shipment.
TERMINOLOGY USED IN OUR LISTINGS:
The definition of the word
stone(s)
can be anything at all. It is only being used as more of a descriptive word/placeholder. These can be anything from genuine gemstone, lab created, synthetic, glass, plastic or crystal "stones". Unless specifically stated as gemstone(s) there will be no returns accepted for jewelry where the word "stone(s)" is used in our listing. Please make sure you understand and take that into account before placing a bid.
Pearls are tested to the best of our ability for texture and layering. They are not professionally tested. Pearls that do not pass the texture and layering test are labeled "faux". The approximate diameter is provided for size only, and the pearl(s) may or may not be perfectly round. 90% of the world's pearls are now cultured and are not naturally occurring. We cannot distinguish between cultured and natural pearls. You are bidding with this knowledge in mind.
Color, when we describe the color (of a stone, gem, bead, or anything that is described by a color), we may have different lighting than you & some of us see colors differently. Please know that the color that is described could be slightly different & a return will not be accepted for this reason.
Amber is determined to be an organic by-product (ie not plastic) and we cannot make any statement as to age or if it has fossilized.
Bakelite has been identified via the scrubbing bubbles test or metal polish.

description:
Collectible Rock and Mineral Specimen Lot
7 Pieces Including Polished Stone Egg and Rough Slabs
Natural Stone and Mineral Specimens
This diverse lapidary and mineral specimen lot features seven natural stone pieces suitable for display, study, or crafting. The grouping includes a polished red and orange marbled stone egg alongside an assortment of rough, raw, and slab specimens showcasing varied mineral textures and formations.
Items Included:
One polished stone egg with red and orange marbling, measuring approximately 2 inches long
Two red and earthy jasper or petrified wood slab sections with natural weathered rinds
One druzy mineral plate featuring fine sparkling microcrystalline surface coverage
Two grey semi-translucent chalcedony and flint fragments with conchoidal fractures
One tan and brown banded stone specimen block
Condition:
All items are in pre-owned condition. The polished egg displays a smooth glossy surface with natural internal fissure lines. The rough rock and slab specimens exhibit natural rough textures, raw fracture edges, surface inclusions, and earth matrix consistent with unpolished geological specimens.

Striking polished stone slice with a flat base that stands beautifully on its own, perfect as a display piece, paperweight, or unique home decor accent. One side features a rough, natural outer surface, while the cut and polished faces reveal dramatic internal crystal structure with subtle banding and color variation. This piece has an organic, earthy look with a translucent interior that catches the light and highlights the natural patterns. It works well on a desk, shelf, or in a mineral and crystal collection, adding texture and visual interest to any space. description:
Raw Mineral & Rock Specimen Lot
Natural Geological Collection
5 Pieces
This assorted collection of five unpolished geological rock and mineral specimens features diverse textures, crystal formations, and mineral compositions. Ranging from crystalline aggregates to metamorphic and mineralized ore samples, this lot is well suited for educational study, earth science reference, or natural decorative display.
Items Included:
Large matrix plate featuring microcrystalline druzy pockets and earthy mineral tones
Coarse-grained crystalline rock specimen with quartz and feldspar matrix
Orange blocky cleavage specimen exhibiting distinct crystal planes
Elongated foliated metamorphic stone with visible mineral layering
Dense mineral ore rock with reddish-brown oxidation and dark metallic tones
Condition:
All five specimens are in natural, rough raw condition as collected. Surfaces exhibit natural fractures, irregular cleavage edges, natural sediment, and mineral veining. Free of artificial polishing or tumbling.

We’re happy to offer combined shipping when items meet ShopGoodwill’s combined-shipping eligibility criteria and can be safely packaged together.If the combined-shipping option is available at checkout, please proceed with payment and your items will be shipped together at a reduced shipping charge. If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.
Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

Descriptions are made by individuals who may not have expertise specific to this type of item, in consultation with local and Internet resources. Shoppers are cautioned to evaluate items based upon their own resources. No guarantee of authenticity is implied unless specifically stated.
How Photography Affects Size Perception
Macro (extreme close-up) photography is heavily utilized in jewelry listings, enabling viewers to examine pieces in larger-than-life detail. An accurate understanding of the actual sizes of these pieces cannot be deduced using photos alone. It is important that the bidder takes close note of the measurements and weights to determine actual sizes.
About Gemstone & Metal Testing
Gemstones are tested with a Presidium Gem Tester. Goodwill of the Olympics & Rainier Region is a member of the International Gem Society; however, as we are not certified gemologists, we cannot guarantee the authenticity of any gemstone unless otherwise stated. Gemstone identification information is provided for your reference and consideration in bidding; no guarantee is implied.
Pearls are tested with a check for grittiness to detect nacre irregularities. We are generally unable to specify pearl types and characteristics; they may be cultured, wild, freshwater or saltwater pearls. Coral may be natural or dyed; most of our coral listings include dyed pieces.
Metals including Gold, Silver, and Platinum are tested using an XRF precious metal analyzer, the Niton XL2 by Thermo Scientific, unless explicitly noted otherwise. XRF (X-ray fluorescence) analysis is a non-destructive testing method able to determine an item's elemental composition. Identification of other non-magnetic metals, including brass, bronze, copper, tin, and titanium, rely on our best estimation, and no guarantee is implied; they have not been tested or positively identified unless explicitly noted otherwise. Some jewelry may contain non-precious metals in clasps or findings, causing parts of the piece to respond to a magnet.

Description:
This bundle presents a diverse collection of crystal and mineral rocks, ideal for collectors, learners, or as decorative accents. The set includes various natural specimens, such as polished geode halves displaying distinct striated patterns, crystalline clusters with glimmering surfaces, and notable mineral samples. Two labeled display cards are included, featuring mounted specimens: one card lists anthracite coal, banded sandstone, copper ore, granite, and marble; the other card displays amethyst, carnelian, jade (missing piece), milky quartz, and tiger eye. Each stone is unique in coloration, texture, and shape, providing both visual appeal and educational value. The assortment will enhance any decor, spark curiosity in geology, or serve as a tactile teaching aid. The items are in used condition with minor handling wear and the jade piece is missing from the display card. Overall, this bundle showcases visually striking and varied stones, suitable for display, collecting, or gifting to crystal enthusiasts. Category: Collectibles & Art

A.C. Gilbert Co.
Metal Microscope Set in Hinged Tin Case
Mid-Century, Circa 1950s
Produced by the renowned A.C. Gilbert Company of New Haven, Connecticut, this vintage No. 9 Microscope Set represents an iconic era of mid-century educational science toys. Housed in its original grey enameled hinged metal carry case with lithographed label, the set features a three-turret optical microscope equipped with a Ramsden eye lens and reflector mirror. Accompanying the instrument are period laboratory accessories including chemical specimen vials, slide boxes, and two original instructional booklets from the Gilbert Hall of Science.
Enameled sheet metal carrying case with handle, latch, and internal fold-out specimen rack

Includes three-objective microscope, test tubes with vintage reagents, slide container, spot plate, and two booklets ("How to Use the Gilbert Microscope" and "Gilbert Glass Blowing")

description:
Hemingray Glass Company Set - 2 Pieces
Hemingray 42 (CD 154)
Aqua, Vintage Mid-Century
This set features two vintage aqua glass insulators produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, identified by the "Hemingray-42" mold mark. The No. 42 model, classified as CD 154 by collectors, was one of the most widely used designs for telephone and telegraph lines across North America during the early-to-mid 20th century. Prized for their deep aqua color and iconic industrial aesthetic, these pieces represent a significant era of American telecommunications history and are staple items for glass insulator collectors.
Pieces Included:
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Condition:
Both insulators are in good vintage condition with characteristic wear expected from outdoor utility use. The glass retains high clarity and its original vibrant aqua hue. As is common with authentic vintage insulators, there are minor fleabites and small chips along the sharp drip points on the beaded base. No large structural cracks or major damage to the wire grooves or top domes observed.
